cues.text: August, nineteen seventy-seven. Enfield, North London.
In a small house on Green Street, Peggy Hodgson hears her children screaming.
Then comes the knocking. Inside the walls.
She reports a chair sliding across the floor. No one is touching it.
For more than a year, toys fly. Drawers slam. Beds shake.
And eleven-year-old Janet begins to speak in a voice that is not hers.
Bill says he died in that house. In a chair, downstairs.
Janet later admitted she faked some of it.
